label: Bottom Nav
title: Bottom Nav
summary: Use a Bottom Nav to move between the top-level sections of an app from any screen.
corePrinciple: Three to five destinations, exactly one Active, always at the bottom.

anatomy.title: A bar of equal destinations
anatomy.description: The bar lays out BottomNavItems in equal shares, marks one Active, and sits on the bottom edge of the screen.
blocks: White surface with a hairline top border.
The destination people are on, in the accent colour.
Names the destination in one or two words.

anatomy.note: White surface with a hairline top border.

configuration.title: Three to five destinations
configuration.description: Every destination gets an equal share of the bar. Fewer destinations mean wider tap targets; five is the most that stays comfortable.
blocks: Each item is about 109 px wide.
About 66 px each, the Figma layout.

examples.title: 3 destinations
examples.description: Each item is about 109 px wide.

examples.title: 5 destinations
examples.description: About 66 px each, the Figma layout.

states.title: One Active, the rest Idle
states.description: The screen tells Bottom Nav which destination is Active through its value. A destination can be disabled while it is temporarily unavailable.
blocks: Only the matching item switches to Active.
Dimmed and skipped by keyboard focus.

examples.title: Active destination
examples.description: Only the matching item switches to Active.

examples.title: Disabled destination
examples.description: Dimmed and skipped by keyboard focus.

sizing.title: Full width, fixed height
sizing.description: Bottom Nav spans its screen and anchors to the bottom edge. Its height comes from the items and the padding, 78 px in the installed package.

content.title: One or two words per destination
content.description: Use short nouns people already know, each with an icon that matches it. A long label wraps and makes that item taller than the rest.

inContext.title: Switch sections of the app
inContext.description: The app keeps the Active value and swaps the screen above when it changes. Bottom Nav only reports which destination was pressed.

doDont.title: Keep navigation calm and predictable
doDont.description: Each pair shows a change you can see in the bar.

sources.title: Use the public Bottom Nav contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Declared, installed, and registry jfs-components versions are 0.1.60. Bottom Nav sets each item’s BottomNavItem / State mode from value and anchors itself to the bottom of its nearest positioned container. Figma draws the bar at 77 px; the installed package renders 78 px. On the web the tab list has no accessible name, even with accessibilityLabel, and the Active tab is not exposed as selected. The guide stays in Light mode because the installed Dark tokens turn Idle labels orange. Item details are in the Bottom Nav Item guide.
